lines.text: With deep sorrow he could wish himself cursed and cut off from Christ for his brothers, the people of Israel.
God's word has not failed; offspring are reckoned through Ishmael, and the promise said Sarah will have a son.
Before the twins were born or did good or bad, the older was said to serve the younger.
God tells Moses He will have mercy on whom He has mercy, and raised Pharaoh up to display His wisdom.
Isaiah says only the remnant will be saved, and without descendants they would have become like Sodom and Gomorrah.
